description: Sends documents to the PixelLetter invoice signing service (action 4) and optionally mails the signed PDF to the invoice recipient. The account needs electronic signatures enabled once in the customer area, otherwise PixelLetter answers with error 046.

files.description: Absolute paths of the documents to send, for example the PDF written by pdf-letter-mcp. Several files are converted and merged into one letter, in this order. Allowed: .pdf, .doc, .xls, .ppt, .rtf, .wpd, .psd, and PDF is the only type that always works.

inlineFiles.description: Documents passed as base64 instead of a path.

base64.description: File content as base64, with or without a data URL prefix.

filename.description: File name including the extension, for example "invoice.pdf". The extension decides the file type.

notification.description: Leave this out and nothing is mailed to the invoice recipient, you only get the signed file yourself.

body.description: Body of the notification e-mail, plain text or HTML.

filename.description: File name of the attached PDF. Defaults to the PixelLetter order number.

sender.description: Sender address of the notification e-mail.

testMode.description: Test mode. true signs with an advanced signature only, which is not legally sufficient, and costs nothing. false creates the qualified signature.

transaction.description: Your own transaction id or short note. PixelLetter returns it with the response.

name: sign_invoice
title: Sign invoice electronically
